meta.source: Sampled from the Alpha Preclinical logo and existing site hero art (alphapreclinical.com), October 2026

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand ink. The wordmark colour; headings and body text on paper and mist. In dark theme it flips to near-white.

tokens.name: abyss
tokens.usage: Deepest wave band and the dark surface: hero, footer, CTA band. White, shallows and ink-on-abyss text only.

tokens.name: tide
tokens.usage: Primary action colour: buttons, links, focus ring. White text on tide passes 7:1.

tokens.name: current
tokens.usage: Middle wave band. Illustration, rules and icons only; never body text on paper (3.1:1).

tokens.name: shallows
tokens.usage: Lightest wave band. Accent text and links on abyss (6.8:1); highlight strokes.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Quiet alternate section background; table stripes.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on paper (7.1:1).

tokens.name: ink-on-abyss
tokens.usage: Secondary text on abyss (7.7:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text and logo on abyss and tide.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter; gap inside lists.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Paragraph and block gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its section content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Vertical section padding on desktop (72px on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Photos, panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons. The only pill shape in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Header once scrolled; open menus. Nothing else casts a shadow.
